title: Recycling facility reporting.
bodyText: Recycling facilities, in addition to any requirements under chapter 342H, shall prepare or maintain the documents involving empty beverage containers, as required by the department.
bodyHtml: [§342G-120]  Recycling facility reporting.  Recycling facilities, in addition to any requirements under chapter 342H, shall prepare or maintain the documents involving empty beverage containers, as required by the department. [L 2002, c 176, pt of §2]
